'''Grefnas''' were avian beasts native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Their prominent cranial spine nerves allowed flock members to visually track others through the undergrowth due to ultraviolet striations on the planet's surface, and served to fend off predators.<ref name="Codex" /> The "Fiery" grefna was a breed of grefna that could be won by attendees of the [[Star Cluster Casino]] and [[Club Vertica Casino]].<ref name="Star Cluster Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Star Cluster Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Club Vertica Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Club Vertica Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grefnas appear in the seventh expansion to the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', [[2019]]'s [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']]. Grefnas can be bought as player mounts.
